item.content:encoded:
I absolutely adore the concept and much of its execution is solid. It's a really neat spin on a spacetime portal. Pun absolutely intended. Plus, I love spiders.

This particular bit jumps out at me, though:

"The [DATA EXPUNGED] and [DATA EXPUNGED] before response teams were dispatched and terminated the Subject after sustaining multiple casualties."

Why would the Foundation selectively expunge around the article and conjunction? It feels really disjointed and artificial to me. I think a solution would be to simply expunge everything in the sentence prior to "before response teams…" for a more natural feel.

This is interesting and it has a cool hook, but I agree it needs less [DATA EXPUNGED].
That said, I think it could use a bit more attention. +53, almost 5 years old, and 5 comments total?

As I understand it, the web's anomalous properties only arise from this particular population of spiders, and it has to be spun by them.
Still, even though the silk appears to be normal in composition, why hasn't the Foundation tried a test where they wove a cloth out of the silk to see whether anything got caught in it? Or is that how they discovered it was the composition?
